verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's docs give a concrete recall figure: the vector index is "automatically tuned for 90-100% recall". They also document a recall endpoint, so users can measure recall themselves and check the claim. However, the pack contains no published latency benchmark numbers; the docs only say "low-latency queries". A community comment praising the site's "juicy data" does not specify which benchmarks it means. Missing for 10: published latency figures (p50/p99), a documented benchmark methodology or reproducible benchmark suite, independent corroboration of the recall and latency numbers.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published benchmarks or measured latency/recall numbers backing the database's performance claims

citations.quote: The vector index is automatically tuned for 90-100% recall ("accuracy")... You can use the recall endpoint to test yourself.
